name: Philter of Shared Tongues
summary: A philter that lets you speak and understand any language for an hour.
description: Diplomats call it "the shortcut" and refuse to say how it tastes. A pearly layer floats on its surface.

stats.effect: When you drink this potion, for 1 hour you can understand any spoken language you hear and be understood by creatures that know at least one language.
